evidence.sawLive: super chill at dusk with the lit ground fountains, string-light trees, and the pearl chimney glowing behind everyone. yeah it's great for night pics, and the caption says free to walk but $12 tacos if you cave.

items.title: river walk for 20 mins, dusk only
items.what: lena took her cousin 'against my will' lol. stone bridge, trees lit purple + green, red-light boat way down the water. do a quick loop for pics then bounce.
items.whyYou: you even commented on this photo — perfect night-owl photographer stop, short and scenic then go eat elsewhere like lena says.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here

items.title: mission san josé, quiet sunday
items.what: long wall of stone arches, two rows, weathered 300 years, green bushes in front. national park. gabe went with abuela, she lit a candle.
items.whyYou: texture + empty frames for your camera, quiet historic vibe for the art side — and free so you stay easy inside that budget.

evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you
